recent.reason: capital floor reached, stopping for good

last.minutes: With only 48 hours remaining and the desk significantly underwater, the priority must shift entirely to capital preservation. The high transaction costs and the 31.2% tax on gains make chasing momentum in a risk-off environment statistically unfavorable. We will remain in cash to avoid further erosion of the remaining capital.
